reviewer: Claude (independent; not the author of the Root operator script)
author: Root Codex operator

target.manifestCheck: 16/16 files match file-manifest.json: 3 by raw bytes, 13 after LF->CRLF conversion (manifest hashed CRLF bytes; Git stores LF)

scope: Static read of the committed script, verifier and receipts. No PowerShell, SSH, reboot, logon, process or network action by the reviewer. The 6.561 s reconnect is Root operator evidence; its arithmetic (20:49:27.4702909 - 20:49:20.9096232 = 6.5607 s) and the event order (SSH_EXITED 20:49:20.934 -> SSH_PROCESS_STARTED 20:49:26.351, 5 s sleep) are internally consistent.
verifiedSound: host key pinned twice: SHA-256 of known_hosts.pinned checked before every start, plus StrictHostKeyChecking=yes with UserKnownHostsFile
BatchMode=yes, IdentitiesOnly=yes, ConnectTimeout=5, ConnectionAttempts=1: no password prompt or agent key fallback
both forward ends bound to 127.0.0.1 (Main 3100/18080 -> PC3 loopback 13103/8080); no LAN exposure
ExitOnForwardFailure=yes plus ServerAliveInterval 15 x 3 makes a dead tunnel exit within about 45 s
occupied-port HOLD never kills a foreign process; abandoned-mutex case handled
state written through temp file + Move-Item; event log rotated at 2 MiB x 2
no credential, token or DSN in state.json/events.jsonl; scope string disclaims auth/DB/Node acceptance
verifier killed only the exact owned child after checking executable, parent, command line, start time and listener ownership; first verifier failure was preserved

findings.title: catch block can throw and end the supervisor
findings.detail: Write-TransportState/Write-TransportEvent run inside catch. If they throw (Move-Item onto state.json while a reader holds it without delete sharing, disk full, ACL), the exception leaves while($true), runs finally and the process exits. Nothing restarts it until the next interactive logon.
findings.fix: guard every state/event write with its own try/catch; never throw from catch; retry the replace; keep an outer loop.

findings.title: no supervision of the supervisor; no headless or reboot start
findings.detail: HKCU Run starts it only at interactive logon. A crash, kill, logoff or reboot without logon leaves no transport. Reboot/logon test is NOT_RUN (Root states this). Earlier S4U task registration failed with 0x80070005.
findings.fix: choose and record one mechanism with restart-on-failure (Task Scheduler at logon + restart policy + periodic watchdog, or a service), then run a real logoff/logon and reboot test.

findings.title: state.json is not a health signal
findings.detail: state is written only on transitions. SSH_PROCESS_STARTED stays unchanged when the supervisor is dead, when ssh is up but the PC3 service is down, or when forwards fail per connection. There is no heartbeat time, no end-to-end probe and no alert.
findings.fix: redacted status collector: supervisor PID+StartTime liveness, listener ownership, fresh HTTP probe with observedAt, freshness limit, alert after N failures.

findings.title: startup command not evidenced
findings.detail: installation.json names the HKCU Run key and value name but not the value data (command line) or its hash, so the startup path to the pinned script cannot be checked.
findings.fix: record the exact Run value data and its SHA-256 (no secrets in it) and check it in the status collector.

findings.title: least privilege of the tunnel key
findings.detail: the always-on tunnel uses the same sv-lan-ed25519 key used for shell SSH to PC1-PC4; no authorized_keys restriction is evidenced.
findings.fix: dedicated tunnel key on PC3 with restrict,port-forwarding,permitopen="127.0.0.1:13103",permitopen="127.0.0.1:8080" and a no-shell command.

findings.title: ssh configuration not isolated
findings.detail: no -F none; user/system ssh_config can add options not set on the command line. GlobalKnownHostsFile is not pinned or disabled.
findings.fix: add -F none and pin or disable the global known-hosts file (check the exact value accepted by the installed OpenSSH).

findings.title: exit code lost
findings.detail: events.jsonl records exitCode null for the observed exit; Start-Process -PassThru objects lose ExitCode unless the handle is cached.

findings.title: orphan ssh child
findings.detail: the child is not in a job object; if the supervisor dies the ssh child keeps the ports unsupervised and a new supervisor waits in HOLD_LOCAL_PORT_OCCUPIED.
findings.fix: job object with kill-on-close, or detect an own orphan by exact command line.

findings.title: fixed retry, no backoff or escalation
findings.detail: permanent errors retry every 5-15 s forever; HOLD_KEY_UNAVAILABLE writes state but no event.
findings.fix: bounded backoff, an event for every HOLD, and an alert threshold.

findings.title: session-local mutex
findings.detail: Local\ mutex is per logon session; a second session can start a second supervisor; only the port guard prevents double binding.
findings.fix: Global\ name or record that single-session use is assumed.

findings.title: UTF-8 BOM
findings.detail: PowerShell 5.1 -Encoding UTF8 writes a BOM; state.json and line 1 of events.jsonl start with it, so strict JSON/JSONL readers fail.

findings.title: transport covers only portal and API
findings.detail: the real IdP (Main:8443, reverse-forwarded to PC3:8443) and the CP DB (Main:55461, reverse-forwarded from PC3:15461) are outside this supervisor; Root observed no listener on 55461/8443 at 20:25 KST and the Main Docker daemon unavailable. Login and DB-backed API calls cannot work through this transport alone.

findings.title: local exposure
findings.detail: any local process on Main can reach the PC3 API and portal through 127.0.0.1; API authentication still applies.

findings.title: healthz is liveness
findings.detail: HTTP 200 /healthz proves process liveness only (Root states this correctly).

implementationOwner: Root (operator script owner). Claude did not edit the script.
